column3: $10Li... Xiao... yao! Li Xiaoyao!~30

column2: $02うわっ！悪逆非道の羅刹鬼婆~40
column3: $02Waaah! Wicked Rakshasa hag~40

column2: お前の手に落ちたからには、
column3: Now that I've fallen into your hands,

column2: 煮るも焼くも好きにしろ！~60
column3: just kill me and be done!~60

column2: へへ……
column3: Heh heh...

column2: 逍遥！部屋にこもって何してるんだい？さっさと出てきてお客さんの相手を手伝いな
column3: Xiaoyao! What are you doing holed up in your room? Get out here and help me look after the guests!

column2: あっ！……今すぐ行くよ
column3: Ah! ...I'll be right there!

column2: 両手で物を運んでいるので降りられない
column3: You can't climb down with your hands full

column2: 両手で物を運んでいるので登れない
column3: You can't climb up with your hands full

column2: あら……この通路は……？
column3: Oh... what is this passage...?

column2: はは～、あの苗族の連中も、俺がここに抜け道を作ってたなんて夢にも思わなかっただろうな。おかげでちょうど君を助けられたってわけさ……
column3: Ha! Those Miao never dreamed I'd built a secret passage here. And it turned out to be just the thing to rescue you...

column2: 霊児……君も登ってみるか？
column3: Ling'er... want to try climbing it yourself?

column2: もう、意地悪～。女の子にこんな所を登らせるなんて、みっともないでしょう！わたし、いやです……
column3: You're so mean! Making a girl climb a thing like this - it would look awful! I won't do it...

column2: 何やってんだい～、のろのろして！
column3: What's taking you so long, you slowpoke!

column2: お客様方……どうぞ中へ……
column3: Dear guests... please, come right in...

column2: 逍遥！お客様方にひと休みしていただきな。あたしは台所で酒と料理の支度をしてくるから……
column3: Xiaoyao! See that our guests can rest their legs. I'll go to the kitchen and get the food and wine ready...

column2: 給仕！この宿は我らが借り切った。主人と店の者以外、関わりのない者は全員出て行ってもらえ
column3: Waiter! We are taking this whole inn. Apart from the owner and the staff, see that everyone with no business here is shown out.

column2: 本日はほかにお客様はおりません。お客様方……あ、いえ！旦那様方、ほかに何かお申し付けはございますか？
column3: We have no other guests today, dear guests... er, no! Might I ask what else you good masters require?

column2: 今後、我らの指図なしに、余計な者を二階へ上げてはならん。分かったな？
column3: From now on, no outsiders are to come upstairs without our say-so. Understood?

column2: へい……お安いご用で。必ず仰せの通りにいたします
column3: Yes... easily done. Your humble servant will see to it.

column2: よろしい！この銀子を取っておけ。これから数日、おとなしく我らの言う通りに働けば、褒美ははずんでやる。
column3: Very good! Take this silver. Do as we tell you like a good lad these next few days, and you won't go short of rewards.

column2: へい～、旦那様、ありがとうございます……当店は必ずや、我が家のようにおくつろぎいただけるようにいたします！
column3: Yes, thank you for your generosity, sir... Our humble inn will make you feel right at home!

column2: 500文を手に入れた
column3: Got 500 coins

column2: わはっ！こりゃ福の神のお出ましだぜ
column3: Wahaha! I've run into the God of Wealth himself!

column2: お客様に失礼のないようにするんだよ
column3: Mind you don't neglect the guests.

column2: 逍遥、ちょうどいいところに来たね。入口にいるあの汚い物乞いを早く追い払っとくれ。商売の邪魔になるからね
column3: Xiaoyao, you're just in time. Go chase off that filthy beggar at the door before he ruins our business.

column2: 忘れるんじゃないよ！あとで台所に来て料理を運ぶのを手伝うんだよ
column3: Don't forget! Come to the kitchen in a bit and help carry the dishes.

column2: もう用はない……仕事に戻れ
column3: That will be all... go about your work.

column2: 何でもない……行っていいぞ
column3: It's nothing... you can go.

column2: おい！給仕、俺たちゃ腹が減ったんだ。早く酒と料理を持ってこい
column3: Hey, waiter! We're starving here. Hurry up and bring the food and wine!

column2: 仕事に戻りな……
column3: Go on about your work...

column2: ふう～、疲れた。早めに休みたいものだ
column3: Ahh... I'm tired. I'd like to turn in early.

column2: ああ～、腹減った！飯はまだ来ないのかよ
column3: Agh, I'm starving! Why hasn't the food come yet?

column2: この部屋はなかなか居心地がよさそうだ。今日はやっとぐっすり眠れるぜ
column3: This room looks pretty comfortable. Finally, a good night's sleep tonight.

column2: 酒と料理を持ってきたのか？私はまだ腹が減っておらん。先に隣の部屋の手下どもに食わせてやれ
column3: Bringing food and wine? I'm not hungry yet. Take it next door for my men first.

column2: この私が腹は減っておらんと言ったのが聞こえなかったのか？下げろ！
column3: I said I'm not hungry - didn't you hear me? Take it away!

column2: 仕事に戻れ……用があればまた呼ぶ
column3: Go about your work... I'll call you if I need anything.

column2: うむ……この鶏の丸焼き、なかなかいい味だ
column3: Mm... this roast chicken's not bad.

column2: 小皿の料理もうまいな……
column3: The side dishes are tasty too...

column2: 食った！食った！
column3: I'm stuffed! Stuffed!

column2: 苗疆からここまで急ぎ通しだったが、やっとまともな飯にありつけたぜ
column3: We've been rushing all the way here from the Miao lands. At last, a proper meal!

column2: たらふく食って飲んで、明日は大仕事だ！
column3: We eat and drink our fill, and tomorrow we're ready for the big job!

column2: 旦那様方！酒と料理をお持ちしました
column3: Sirs! Your food and wine are here.

column2: 持って入れ！
column3: Bring it in!

column2: ん～、こりゃ何の酒だ？ちっとも味がしねえぞ！
column3: Hm? What kind of wine is this? It's got no taste at all!

column2: おや！旦那様はご存じないようで。この酒はこの土地の名物、桂花酒でございまして、香り高くまろやかなことこの上なし、今の貴妃様までもがこよなく愛飲なさっているんですよ！
column3: Oh! You may not know, sir, but this is our local specialty - Osmanthus Wine. Fragrant, sweet and mellow beyond compare. Why, even the Imperial Consort at court can't get enough of it!

column2: 下げろ！下げろ！俺たちは強い酒に慣れてるんだ。女の飲むような酒なんぞいらん。
column3: Take it away! Take it away! We're used to strong liquor. We don't want some women's drink.

column2: それでは……別のを一本お持ちいたします
column3: Then... I'll fetch you a different jug.

column2: いらん！酒なら自分たちで持ってきてある。
column3: Don't bother! We brought our own.

column2: 李逍遥は桂花酒を懐にしまった
column3: Li Xiaoyao tucked the Osmanthus Wine away in his robe

column2: 苗族の手下：\n漢人の薬草だって、どんな病でも治せるわけじゃない。やはり俺たち苗族の巫術のほうが上だ。苗疆には拝月教というのがあって、死人を生き返らせる術を使うそうだぜ
column3: Miao Henchman:\nYou Han and your herbs can't cure every sickness. Our Miao witchcraft is the stronger art. Back in the Miao lands there's the Moon-Worship Cult - they say it has a spell that brings the dead back to life.

column2: 苗族の手下：\nおかみが病気になったそうだな？
column3: Miao Henchman:\nI hear the landlady's fallen ill?

column2: 苗族の手下：\nこいつはまずいな……十里四方に宿はここ一軒だけだ。俺たちは今晩どこで飲み食いすりゃいいんだ？
column3: Miao Henchman:\nThis is bad... This is the only inn for ten li around. Where are we supposed to eat and drink tonight?

column2: 李おばさん：\nあの物乞いは追い払ったかい？
column3: Aunt Li:\nHave you sent that beggar packing yet?

column2: 李おばさん：\n逍遥！卓の上の酒と料理を早く二階へ運びな！
column3: Aunt Li:\nXiaoyao! Hurry and take the food and wine on the table upstairs!

column2: 李おばさん：\nそこでぼさっと突っ立ってないで手伝っとくれ。忙しくて手が回らないんだよ！
column3: Aunt Li:\nDon't just stand there gawking - lend a hand! I can barely keep up!

column2: 俺は……小さい頃に父さんと母さんを亡くして、おばさんが女手一つでここまで育ててくれたんだ。おばさんにとっても身内は俺一人だけ。何としてでも治せる人を見つけてみせる
column3: I... lost my father and mother when I was little, and it was Auntie who raised me all by herself. I'm the only family she has, too. I have to find someone who can cure her, whatever it takes.

column2: でも……洪医師でさえ助からないと言ってる。俺……俺はどうすればいいんだ？
column3: But... even Doctor Hong says there's no hope. What... what am I supposed to do?

column2: 卓の上に豪勢な酒と料理が並んでいる。うーん、実にうまそうだ
column3: A lavish spread of food and wine sits on the table. Mmm... it looks delicious

column2: そう！その皿だよ。早く二階のお客様へ持っておいき
column3: Yes! That's the one. Hurry and take it up to the guests upstairs.

column2: ぼろをまとった酔っ払いが入口に寝転がっている
column3: A drunkard in tattered clothes is lying in the doorway

column2: しっ、しっ！うちだって貧乏なんだ。お前にやる金なんかないぞ
column3: Shoo, shoo! We're poor too. We've got no money to spare for you.

column2: 金が欲しいのではない、ちょいと酒を恵んでほしいだけじゃ。なあ兄ちゃん～、頼むよ……酒を少しおくれ
column3: I'm not after money, I only want a drop of wine. Come on, little brother... just give me a bit of wine.

column2: だめだ！だめだ！おばさんに知れたら間違いなくどやされる。早く行ってくれよ！
column3: No way! No way! If Auntie finds out, I'll catch it for sure. Go on, get moving!

column2: やれやれ！酒がなくては一歩も歩けんのじゃ。情けをかけておくれ……
column3: Aiya! Without a drink I can't walk another step. Have a heart...

column2: 頼むよ～、兄ちゃん……ほんのひと口飲めればそれでいいんじゃ
column3: Please, little brother... just one little sip is all I need.

column2: 酒……頼む……ひと口でいい
column3: Wine... I beg you... just one sip.

column2: こんなにしつこい飲んだくれは見たことないぜ
column3: I've never seen such a shameless drunk.

column2: 酒……頼む……酒をくれ……
column3: Wine... I beg you... give me wine...

column2: だめだめ～、これはお客さんに出す酒なんだ
column3: No, no - this is for the guests.

column2: 酒……頼……む……ひと口……ひと口……だけで
column3: Wine... I beg... you... one sip... just... one sip...

column2: 酒……頼……む……ひと口……ひと口……だけで
column3: Wine... I beg... you... one sip... just... one sip...

column2: かわいそうだから、ひと口だけ飲ませてやるよ。おい～、ひと口だけだぞ！
column3: You look so pitiful, I'll let you have one sip. Hey - one sip only!

column2: ああ…………いい酒じゃ！
column3: Ahhh... fine wine!

column2: あっ……なんで全部飲んじまうんだよ！
column3: Hey... how come you drank it all!

column2: げっぷ～。わしのひと口はこのくらい大きいんじゃ。いやはや、すまんのう……
column3: Burp! That's just how big one sip of mine is. Terribly sorry about that...

column2: お……お前、弁償しろ！
column3: You... you'd better pay me back!

column2: ほっほ……金ならないぞ。お主、剣を習いたくてたまらんのじゃろ？
column3: Heh heh... money I haven't got. But you're dying to learn the sword, aren't you?

column2: なんで知ってるんだ？
column3: How did you know?

column2: 酒に免じて、貧道が特別に二、三手ほど指南してやろう
column3: For the sake of that wine, this poor Taoist will make an exception and show you a few moves.

column2: ……あ……あんたが俺に剣法を教える？？
column3: ...You... you're going to teach me swordplay??

column2: おじいさん……からかわないでくださいよ。早く行ったほうがいい。あなたに酒を飲ませたなんておばさんに知れたら、絶対に怒鳴られるんだ
column3: Old uncle... please quit pulling my leg. You'd really better go. If my aunt finds out I gave you wine, she'll scold me for sure.

column2: はっはっは！では明日の晩の三更、十里坡の"山神廟"じゃ。来るまで待っておるぞ！
column3: Hahaha! Then tomorrow night at the third watch, the "Mountain God Temple" on Ten-Mile Slope. Be there - I'll be waiting!

column2: 酔いどれ道士は言い終えると、煙のように姿を消した……
column3: With that, the Drunken Taoist vanished like a wisp of smoke...

column2: あれ～、どこ行った？
column3: Huh? Where'd he go?

column2: 逍遥～、ちょっとおいで！
column3: Xiaoyao, come here a moment!

column2: 暇があるなら、市場へ行って新鮮な海老を何斤か買ってきておくれ。市場で買えなかったら、漁師の船の人たちに聞いてみな
column3: If you've got time, go to the market and buy me a few catties of fresh shrimp. If the market has none, ask around among the fishing boats.

column2: 50文を手に入れた
column3: Got 50 coins

column2: ふう……助かった
column3: Phew... that was close.

column2: 何をぶつぶつ言ってるんだい？
column3: What are you muttering about?

column2: 何でもない！今すぐ行くよ
column3: Nothing! I'm on my way!

column2: いいかい！新鮮なのだけ買うんだよ
column3: Remember! Only buy them if they're fresh.

column2: ねえ～　知ってるかい？塩売りの王さんがね、先月おかしな病気にかかって、どの医者にも手の施しようがないって言われたんだよ。それでどうなったと思う？
column3: Hey, have you heard? Old Wang the salt seller came down with some strange illness last month, and every doctor said there was no cure. And guess what happened?

column2: どうなったんだい？王さんならぴんぴんしてるじゃないか！
column3: What happened? Old Wang's alive and well!

column2: それがね、息子の小虎が"仙霊島"まで行って、必死に頼み込んだら、島の仙女様が仙丹を一粒くださったんだって。王さんがその仙丹を飲んだら、病がたちまち半分以上よくなったんだよ。
column3: That's because his son Xiaohu went all the way to "Xianling Isle" and begged for dear life, until a fairy on the island gave him a magic pill. Old Wang took it, and right away he was more than halfway cured.

column2: そんな珍しいことが本当にあるのかい？　へえ～、見かけによらず、小虎もやるもんだねえ。
column3: Is there really such a marvel? Well, well - who'd have thought little Xiaohu had it in him.

column2: よく言うじゃないか……善人には良い運が巡るって。それに王さんは普段からよく人助けをしてるし、お天道様はちゃんと見てるってことだね……
column3: As the saying goes... good people have good fortune. And Old Wang has always been kind and charitable. I'd say Heaven has eyes...

column2: あら～、李坊！おばさんはまだ店で忙しいのかい？ここへ洗濯に来ないじゃないか……
column3: Hey there, Little Li! Is your aunt still busy at the inn? I haven't seen her come to do her washing...

column2: そうなんだ……今朝早くから泊まり客の一行が来てさ
column3: Yeah... a bunch of people showed up first thing this morning wanting rooms.

column2: 李おばさんは本当に苦労性だねえ……
column3: Aunt Li was just born to toil...

column2: 洗って～　洗って～
column3: Scrub, scrub... scrub, scrub...

column2: あたしが思うにね～、李おばさんはきっと働きすぎで病気になったんだよ！
column3: If you ask me, Aunt Li worked herself sick, that's what!

column2: はあ～　誰がために苦労し、誰がために忙しく……苦労性だねえ……
column3: Sigh... for whom do we toil, for whom do we slave... Born to toil, we are...

column2: コッ……コッ……たんとお食べ、早く大きくなるんだよ……
column3: Cluck... cluck... Eat up now, and grow big quick...

column2: 逍遥兄ちゃん！今日もまた林へ鳥の巣を探しに連れてってよ、ねえいいでしょ
column3: Brother Xiaoyao! Take me to the woods to look for bird nests again today, okay?

column2: 小虎、兄ちゃんはまだ用事があって忙しいんだ。今日は連れてってやれないぞ……
column3: Xiaohu, your big brother's still got things to do. I can't take you today...

column2: うう……残念だなあ。じゃあ明日……明日は連れてってよ！
column3: Aww... too bad. Then tomorrow... take me tomorrow!

column2: はは……また今度な
column3: Heh... we'll see.

column2: 明日は絶対遊びに連れてってよ。ずるはなしだよ！
column3: You have to take me out to play tomorrow. No weaseling out of it!

column2: 分かった、分かった。ほら、遊んでこい！
column3: All right, all right. Go on and play!

column2: 大変！大変よ！李のお兄さん……李……李おばさんが……おばさんが……
column3: Oh no! Oh no! Brother Li... Aunt... Aunt Li... she...

column2: おばさんがどうしたんだ？
column3: What's happened to my aunt?

column2: あなたが出かけて間もなく……李おばさんが突然倒れたの！洪医師が、すぐに帰ってきてほしいって
column3: Not long after you left... Aunt Li suddenly collapsed! Doctor Hong wants you to come home at once.

column2: おばさんがどうして……分かった……すぐ帰る！
column3: How could Auntie... All right... I'm going right back!

column2: 姉さんから聞いたんだけど～、李おばさんが病気って本当？あたしに手伝えることはない？
column3: My big sister says Aunt Li is sick - is it true? Is there anything I can do to help?

column2: ああ……どうしてこんなことに
column3: Oh dear... how could this happen?

column2: 李おばさんの病気、重いの？
column3: Is Aunt Li's illness serious?

column2: 李のお兄さん！早く帰ってあげて。李おばさんの病気、かなり重いみたいなの
column3: Brother Li! Hurry home. Aunt Li's illness looks very serious.

column2: どう、李おばさんは少しよくなった？
column3: How is she? Is Aunt Li any better?

column2: 小虎……お前が洪医師を呼んできてくれたのか？
column3: Xiaohu... were you the one who fetched Doctor Hong?

column2: うん～、逍遥兄ちゃん！兄ちゃんの家に来たら、李おばさんが台所で倒れてたんだ。それで急いで洪医師を呼びに走ったんだよ
column3: Yes, Brother Xiaoyao! I came over to your place and saw Aunt Li lying on the kitchen floor, so I ran straight off to get Doctor Hong.

column2: ありがとな、小虎！
column3: Thanks, Xiaohu!

column2: ねえ～、李おばさん、大丈夫かなあ？
column3: Do you think... Aunt Li's going to be all right?

column2: 小虎、お前、本当に島で仙人に霊薬をもらって、親父さんの病気を治したのか？
column3: Xiaohu, did you really get a magic medicine from the immortals on that island and cure your dad?

column2: そうだよ……逍遥兄ちゃん！兄ちゃんも"仙霊島"へ薬をもらいに行けばいいよ。仙女のお姉ちゃんがくれた丹薬、本当によく効くんだ
column3: That's right... Brother Xiaoyao! You can go to "Xianling Isle" and ask for medicine too. The pill the fairy sister gave me really works wonders.

column2: 仙女？
column3: A fairy?

column2: うそじゃないよ。あの仙女のお姉ちゃん、すっごくきれいで、すっごく優しいんだ……
column3: I'm not lying. That fairy sister is sooo pretty, and sooo kind too...

column2: 教えてくれてありがとな……俺、仙霊島へ行ってこようと思う。おばさんのこと、頼んでもいいか
column3: Thanks for telling me all this... I'm going to make a trip to Xianling Isle. Could I ask you to look after my aunt?

column2: うん！任せて！
column3: Sure! No problem!

column2: でも最近はお天道様が怒ってて、波風がすごいから、海に出るのはとっても危ないよ
column3: But the heavens have been angry lately. The wind and waves are fierce, so going out to sea is really dangerous.

column2: 李おばさんが無事でありますように。でないと、もうおばさんの作るちまきが食べられなくなっちゃう
column3: I hope Aunt Li pulls through. Otherwise I'll never get to eat her zongzi dumplings again.

column2: どこをほっつき歩いておった？おばさんが倒れたのを知らんのか！
column3: Where have you been? Don't you know your aunt has collapsed!

column2: はい……おばさんはどうして急に倒れたんですか？俺が出かけるときは元気だったのに
column3: Yes... But why did she collapse so suddenly? She was perfectly fine when I left.

column2: おばさんの病はもう長いこと続いておったのじゃ。ただ、ずっとお前に隠しておっただけでな……
column3: Your aunt has been ill for a long time now. She's just been hiding it from you all along...

column2: そ……それで、重いんですか？お願いです、先生～、いくらかかっても構いません、どうか必ず治してください……
column3: Then... is it serious? Please, Doctor - I don't care what it costs, you have to cure her...

column2: はあ～、長く患って手当てもせず、そのうえ過労が重なっては、おそらく……望みはない。
column3: Sigh... An illness left untreated so long, on top of overwork... I'm afraid... there is no hope.

column2: えっ！そんなはずない、お願いです！先生、どうかおばさんを助けてください！
column3: What! That can't be - please! Doctor, you have to save my aunt!

column2: 薬を一服出して試してはみるが、人事を尽くすことしかできん。あとでわしの薬屋まで薬を取りに来なさい……
column3: I'll prescribe something and we'll try, but it's only doing what little can be done. Come by my apothecary in a while to pick up the medicine...

column2:
ふふ～、お前たち漢人の書物にこんな言葉があるな。
"樹静かならんと欲すれども風止まず"
"子養わんと欲すれども親待たず"……
まさに至言ではないか～
column3:
Heh heh... You Han have a saying in your books:
"The tree would be still, but the wind will not cease"
"The child would care for his parents, but they will not wait"...
Wise words indeed.

column2: 俺……俺は絶対におばさんを死なせない。命がけでも治す方法を見つけてみせる
column3: I... I will never let my aunt die. Even if it costs me my life, I'll find a way to cure her.

column2: ははは！見上げた孝行心だ。大慈大悲の菩薩様も、きっとお前に心を動かされることだろう……
column3: Haha! Such filial devotion is rare. Surely even the all-merciful Bodhisattva will be moved by you...

column2: 菩薩様……？
column3: The Bodhisattva...?

column2: お前は仙霊島へ仙薬を求めに行きたいのだろう？だが……仙縁のない者は、島に張られた仙術の結界を通り抜けることはできん
column3: You wish to go to Xianling Isle and seek the immortals' medicine, do you not? But... one with no immortal affinity cannot pass the magic wards upon the island.

column2: はい！はい！どうか旦那様、お教えください
column3: Yes! Yes! I beg you, sir, tell me what to do!

column2: 仙霊島の中央に"水月宮"という宮があり、丹薬作りに長けた仙女たちが住んでいる。だが宮の外には仙術で作られた迷いの陣がある。邪法や妖術を持たぬ凡人ならば、陣の仕掛けに傷つけられることはない。しかし陣の要を破れぬかぎり、一生かけても水月宮のありかは見つからん
column3: At the heart of Xianling Isle stands the "Water Moon Palace", home to a group of fairy maidens skilled in refining elixirs. But outside the palace lies a maze laid down by immortal magic. An ordinary mortal with no dark arts or sorcery will not be harmed by its traps - yet unless you break the eye of the formation, you could spend your whole life searching and never find the palace.

column2: じゃあ、俺はどうすればいいんです？
column3: Then what should I do?

column2: 陣の中には阿修羅の神像が六体ある。この"破天鎚"でその石像を一つずつ打ち砕けば、迷いの陣の中央に"光る石板"が現れる。その時、石板の上に乗りさえすれば、道はおのずと現れる
column3: Within the maze stand six Asura statues. Smash those stone statues one by one with this "Skybreaker", and a "glowing stone slab" will appear at the center of the maze. Then you need only step onto the slab, and the way will reveal itself.

column2: あ……あんた、どうしてそれを？
column3: How... how do you know all this?

column2: お前の孝行心を見込んで、この天機を漏らしてやったのだ。くれぐれも好機を逃すでないぞ
column3: Only because I see your filial heart do I reveal this secret of Heaven. Do not let the chance slip away.

column2: そうだ……　ここに丸薬が一粒ある。これを飲めば、仙霊島の瘴気に侵されずにすむ……
column3: Ah yes... I have a pill here. Swallow it, and the miasma of Xianling Isle will not harm you...

column2: 瘴気？
column3: Miasma?

column2: 私の言う通りにすればよい。おばさんを助けたくないのか？
column3: Just do as I say. Or do you not want to save your aunt?

column2: 分かった！　あんたを信じる
column3: All right! I'll trust you.

column2: 李逍遥は破天鎚を受け取り、\n"苗族にもらった丸薬（忘憂散）を飲んだ"
column3: Li Xiaoyao took the Skybreaker and swallowed\n"the pill the Miao gave him - Forget-Sorrow Powder"

column2: しっかりやれ……吉報を待っているぞ
column3: Good luck... I shall await your good news.

column2: 若い者はもっとまめに働かにゃいかん。食っちゃ寝の怠け者の真似はするなよ！
column3: A young man ought to be hardworking. Don't go taking after those lazy gluttons!

column2: 李おばさんも本当に苦労しとる。長年後家を通して、一人でこの宿を切り盛りし、お前を女手一つで育て上げたんじゃ。お前はな～、しっかり孝行せにゃならんぞ！
column3: Aunt Li has had it hard. A widow all these years, running that inn by herself and raising you single-handed. You, lad - you ought to be good to her!

column2: はい～、丁おじさん、分かってるって。
column3: Yes, Uncle Ding, I know, I know.

column2: 小言を言いたいわけじゃないが、お前ももういい年じゃろうに、一日中ふらふらしおって。仕事を見つけて、真面目に生きるべきじゃ
column3: I don't mean to nag, but you're a grown lad now and still fooling around all day. You should find some work and live like an honest man.

column2: うちの娘二人にしょっちゅうちょっかいを出すのはやめてくれ。わしにはこの二人の娘しかおらんのじゃ！
column3: And stop coming around to tempt my two girls! Those two daughters are all I've got!

column2: そんなことしてないよ！丁おじさん……もうろくしちゃ困るぜ。おじさんの大事な娘二人のほうが、しょっちゅう俺とおばさんの機嫌を取りに来るんだ。
column3: I'm doing no such thing! Uncle Ding... don't go senile on me. It's those two precious daughters of yours who keep coming around to butter up me and my aunt.

column2: はあ～、お前たちにはもう何も言う気にならん……
column3: Sigh... I can't be bothered scolding the lot of you anymore...

column2: 李のお兄さん……おはよう～。わたし……あの……
column3: Brother Li... good morning. I... I was thinking...

column2: ん？何だい……言ってみなよ！
column3: Oh? What is it... go on, say it!

column2: な……何でもないの……
column3: N... nothing...

column2: 李のお兄さん、わたし……家で臘八粥をひと鍋煮たの。あなたと李おばさん、もしお暇なら、夕飯のあとにでもいらして、わたしの腕前を味わってみて
column3: Brother Li, I... I've made a pot of Laba porridge at home. If you and Aunt Li have time, do come over after supper and try my cooking.

column2: いいね……もちろん……香蘭姉さんの作る甘味は評判だからな。おばさんが言ってたぜ……この前ごちそうになったお汁粉、口の中が今でも甘いってさ
column3: Sure... of course... Sister Xianglan's sweets are famous. My aunt says... ever since that red bean soup you treated us to, her mouth's been sweet to this day.

column2: ふふ……きっと来てね！
column3: Hee hee... be sure to come!

column2: あら？うちの麻袋がどうして一つ足りないのかしら。まさか猫がくわえていったんじゃないわよね！
column3: Hm? Why is one of our burlap sacks missing? Surely a cat didn't carry it off!

column2: 李兄さん、今日はどうしてこんなに早起きなの
column3: Brother Li, what are you doing up so early today?

column2: あ……おはよう。秀蘭ちゃんこそ、こんな朝早くから丁おじさんの手伝いで水を汲んで畑に水やりか。
column3: Oh... morning. And you, little Xiulan, out this early carrying water for Uncle Ding's vegetables?

column2: そうよ……誰もがあなたみたいに暇じゃないの。姉さんなんて今日は夜明け前に起きて、甘いお粥を大鍋いっぱい炊いてたのよ。誰に食べさせるつもりなのかしらね？　あとであなたにあげたい物があるの。しばらくしたらまた取りに来て
column3: You bet... not everyone's as idle as you. My big sister got up before dawn today and cooked a huge pot of sweet porridge - now who could that be for, I wonder? I have something to give you later. Come back for it in a little while.

column2: 李兄さん……おはよう～
column3: Brother Li... morning!

column2: そんなに急いで欲しいの……ふふっ！ほら……これ、あたしが自分で縫った布靴よ。足に合うかどうか履いてみて？
column3: In such a hurry for it, are you... Hee hee! Look... a pair of Cloth Boots I sewed with my own hands. Try them on and see if they fit?

column2: おっ！ありがとな
column3: Oh! Thank you.

column2: あたしが布靴を縫ってあげたこと、父さんと姉さんには言っちゃだめよ……
column3: You mustn't tell my father or my sister that I made you those boots...

column2: 言い伝えではのう～、その昔、観音菩薩が仙霊島を通りかかり、島の地気が霊妙で、さながら神仙の住まいのようなのをご覧になって、侍香龍女とともにそこに留まり修行なさったそうじゃ。凡人は決して冒してはならんぞ
column3: Legend has it... that long ago the Bodhisattva Guanyin passed by Xianling Isle and saw that the island's air was so pure and wondrous, the very image of an immortals' abode, that she stayed there to cultivate with her incense-bearing Dragon Maiden. Mortals must never trespass there.

column2: じゃが仙霊島の周りには険しい暗礁と隠れた潮流がびっしりで、島の上も奇岩と密林に囲まれておる。やっとの思いで島に上がった者も、まるで迷いの陣に踏み込んだようで、どう回っても島の奥へ通じる道が見つからんのじゃ
column3: But Xianling Isle is ringed with treacherous reefs and hidden currents, and the island itself is girdled by strange rocks and dense forest. Those who do manage to land find it's like walking into a maze - however they circle, they can never find the way inland.

column2: ほっほ……それにな、仙霊島で、天女のように美しい青衣の少女が、玉の瓶と宝剣を手に天から舞い降りるのを見た者もおるそうじゃ。きっと侍香龍女じゃろうな……ほっほ……わしはこの年まで生きてきたが、神仙がどんな姿か見たこともないわい！
column3: Heh heh... I've also heard that someone once saw a maiden in blue on Xianling Isle, lovely as a goddess, descending from the sky with a jade vase and a precious sword in her hands. That must have been the Dragon Maiden... Heh heh... I've lived to this ripe old age and never once seen what an immortal looks like!

column2: しーっ……魚が逃げてしまうわい
column3: Shh... you'll scare the fish away.

column2: この二日ばかり波風がひどすぎる。無理して漁に出たのに、一匹も獲れやしねえ。まったくついてないぜ！
column3: The wind and waves have been too rough these past two days. I forced myself out to fish and didn't net a single one. What rotten luck!

column2: あいつらのほら話なんか聞くなよ。俺もあの仙霊島に行ったことがあるが、仙女なんてどこにいるもんか？
column3: Don't listen to their tall tales. I've been to that Xianling Isle myself - fairies, my foot!

column2: いたのは年寄りで不細工な、おっかない太った婆さん一人だけだ。俺を見るなり有無を言わさず追い出しやがった！
column3: There was only a fat, fierce old hag, ugly as sin. The moment she saw me she chased me off without a word!

column2: あんたら、お化けでも見たんじゃないのか？あんな無人島に人がいるわけ……
column3: Are you sure you people weren't seeing ghosts? How could anybody be living on that deserted island...

column2: 逍遥よ、店は暇なのか？手伝いに帰らないで、こんな所をぶらぶらして。李おばさんに知れたら、間違いなくどやされるぞ
column3: Xiaoyao, my lad, nothing to do at the inn? Wandering around here instead of going back to help - if Aunt Li finds out, you're in for a scolding.

column2: 天の神様……どうか今日こそ漁に出て魚が獲れますように。このままじゃ、一家そろって干上がっちまう……
column3: Heaven preserve us... let me catch some fish when I go out today. Any more of this and my whole family will be living on thin air...

column2: 海に出たいって？こいつは遊びじゃないんだぞ。確かに俺は仙霊島に行ったことがあるが、もう日も傾いてきたし、夜になれば波風はもっとひどくなる……
column3: You want to go out to sea? This is no game. I've been to Xianling Isle, true enough, but it's getting late, and come nightfall the wind and waves will only get worse...

column2: 張四兄さん～、どうか何としても力を貸してくれ。おばさんの命を救うにはこの方法しかないんだ
column3: Brother Zhang Si - please, you've got to help me no matter what. This is the only way to save my aunt's life.

column2: そりゃ…………分かった！やってみよう。李おばさんは普段から人によくしてくれてる。お天道様だって善人を哀れんでくれるだろうさ
column3: Well......... all right! I'll give it a try. Aunt Li has always been good to folks. I reckon Heaven will take pity on a good person.

column2: 行くぞ～、船に乗れ！
column3: Let's go - climb aboard!

column2: もらってきた丹薬が本当に効くといいな
column3: I hope that pill you begged for really works.

column2: 明日はいい天気になるといいがな
column3: Here's hoping for fair weather tomorrow.

column2: 李坊！聞いてくれよ……昨日、海に出たときに、東の島でそりゃあ美しい仙女を見たんだ！惜しいことに、俺が岸に上がったら姿が消えちまってな
column3: Little Li! Listen to this... Yesterday when I was out at sea, I saw the most beautiful fairy on the island to the east! Pity she'd vanished by the time I got ashore.

column2: ほら吹くなって……北村の大足の婆さんのことだって、いつも美人だって褒めてるじゃないか
column3: Quit your bragging... You're always going on about how pretty Big-Foot Granny from North Village is, too.

column2: それは……今度は本当なんだ！あんなに美しい娘は生まれてこのかた見たことがない……
column3: Well... this time I mean it! I've never seen a girl that beautiful in all my life...

column2: ははは……水生おじさん……嫁さんが欲しすぎて頭がおかしくなったんじゃないの
column3: Hahaha... Uncle Shuisheng... I think wanting a wife has driven you crazy.

column2: 本当だって！東の仙霊島には本当に仙女が住んでるんだ。この目で見たんだ！
column3: It's true! There really is a fairy living on Xianling Isle to the east. I saw her with my own eyes!

column2: 水生おじさん！人助けは火事場と同じで一刻を争うんだ！お願いだ、俺を仙霊島へ連れてってくれ！
column3: Uncle Shuisheng! Saving a life is like fighting a fire - there's no time to lose! Please, take me to Xianling Isle!

column2: 何だと！こんなに波風が強いのに、命が惜しくないのか？昨日だって仙女に見とれて、船がひっくり返りかけたんだ。二度と行くもんか！
column3: What! With waves like these? Are you tired of living? I nearly capsized yesterday ogling that fairy. I'm not going back there!

column2: 水生おじさん～、頼むよ……おじさんはこの辺りで一番年季の入った漁師じゃないか。おじさんに無理なら、ほかに誰ができるっていうんだ？
column3: Uncle Shuisheng, I'm begging you... You're the most seasoned fisherman in these parts. If you can't do it, who can?

column2: だめなものはだめだ！ほかを当たれ！
column3: No means no! Go find someone else!

column2: おや～、李坊じゃないか。またうちの船問屋に手伝いに来ないか？
column3: Well now, if it isn't Little Li. How about coming back to help out at my shipping house?

column2: やめとくよ……あんなちょっぴりの給金で、毎日あんなにたくさんの荷を運ばされて、くたくただ。やってられないぜ……
column3: No thanks... Such measly pay for hauling all that cargo every day - it's exhausting. I'm not doing that again...

column2: それなら……給金を上げよう！この船は蘇州まで荷を運ぶんだが、絹織物を少し運ぶだけだ、楽なもんだよ。
column3: Then... I'll raise your pay! This ship is carrying cargo to Suzhou - just some silks and satins. Easy work.

column2: はは……また今度な！その気になったら訪ねるよ
column3: Heh... we'll see! I'll come find you when I'm in the mood.

column2: はあ……今どきの若い者はみんな苦労を嫌がって、誰も船乗りになろうとせん。これじゃ……船も出せんし、商売もあがったりだ。
column3: Sigh... Young people these days are all afraid of hard work, and nobody wants to be a boatman. At this rate... the ship can't sail, and I can forget about business.

column2: あら……海老かい？この二日ばかり波風がちょっとひどくてね、漁師たちも魚が獲れないのさ。だから新鮮な海老も売り物がないんだよ……
column3: Oh... looking for shrimp? The wind and waves have been a bit too rough these two days, and the boatmen can't bring in a catch. So there's no fresh shrimp to be had...

column2: どうだい？魚を一匹買って汁物にでもしなよ。釣り上げたばかりだよ！活きがいいんだから
column3: How about it? Take a fish home for soup. Just caught! Fresh as can be.

column2: 李おばさんはまだ眠り続けている……
column3: Aunt Li is still unconscious...

column2: 李おばさんは紫金丹を飲んだ……
column3: Aunt Li took the Violet Elixir...

column2: ど……どうしたんだ、頭がくらくらする？
column3: Wh... why is my head spinning?

column2: 李逍遥が先に飲んだ忘憂散が\n"効き始め、その場に倒れた……"
column3: The Forget-Sorrow Powder Li Xiaoyao took earlier\n"took effect, and he collapsed on the floor..."
Night...

column2: 逍遥！自分の部屋で寝ないで、こんな所に転がって何してるんだい？
column3: Xiaoyao! Why are you lying here instead of sleeping in your own room?

column2: うっ……　俺、なんでここに！？
column3: Ugh... What am I doing here!?

column2: そうだ！おばさん……とても大事な話があるんだ
column3: That's right! Auntie... I have something really important to tell you.

column2: 何だい？！
column3: What is it?!

column2: それは……それは……あれ？なんで急に思い出せないんだ。確かに……確かに……
column3: It's... it's... Huh? Why can't I remember all of a sudden? I know I... I know I...

column2: 李逍遥は昨日仙霊島へ出発してから\n"薬を持ち帰るまでの記憶をすべて失った"
column3: Li Xiaoyao has lost all memory from setting out for Xianling Isle\n"yesterday until returning with the medicine"

column2: また寝ぼけてるんだろ！部屋に戻って寝な！
column3: You've been dreaming again, that's what! Back to your room and sleep!

column2: おかしいな……何かすごく大事なことがあった気がするのに、どうしても思い出せない……？
column3: Strange... I feel like there was something really important, but I just can't remember it...?

column2: あっ……忘れるところだった！酒をねだってたあの老道士が言ってたっけ～、山神廟で……俺に剣法を教えてくれるって……
column3: Whoa... I almost forgot! That old Taoist who was begging for wine said... the Mountain God Temple... he'd teach me swordplay...

column2: どうせ眠れないんだ、会いに行ってみるか？もしかしたら本当に達人に出会ったのかもしれないぜ
column3: I can't sleep anyway, so why not go and meet him? Maybe I really have run into a great master.

column2: おばさんの部屋から声がする……
column3: A voice comes from Auntie's room...

column2: 逍遥かい？　どこへ行くんだい？こんな夜更けにまだ寝ないのかい？また抜け出して遊び歩くつもりじゃないだろうね？
column3: Is that you, Xiaoyao? Where are you going? Why aren't you asleep at this hour? You're not thinking of sneaking out to fool around again, are you?

column2: あ……何でもない。今、部屋に戻るところだよ
column3: Ah... it's nothing. I'm just going back to my room.

column2: あんたたちが出てすぐ、苗族の男が大金を出して水生おじさんの船を借りたんだよ。水生おじさんは二つ返事で引き受けてね。今度はどこの色町へ飲みに行ったんだか
column3: Not long after you left, a Miao man paid a big pile of silver to hire Uncle Shuisheng's boat, and Uncle Shuisheng agreed on the spot. Who knows which pleasure house he's off drinking in this time.

column2: この頃は金さえあれば、首が飛ぶような商売だって引き受ける奴がいるんだからね
column3: These days, so long as there's money in it, there's always someone willing to take a job that could cost him his head.

column2: 若いの、霊薬は手に入ったようだな？
column3: Well, young man, you obtained the magic medicine, I take it?

column2: 霊薬！？　何の霊薬だ？
column3: Magic medicine!? What magic medicine?

column2: ふふ……やはり効いたか……そうだ！今は何刻だ
column3: Heh heh... so it worked... By the way! What hour is it now?

column2: ああ……三更だよ
column3: Oh... it's the third watch.

column2: うむ～、頃合いだな
column3: Mm... it is time.

column2: 若いの、我らはこれから用があって出かける。戻るのは明日の朝だ。もう店じまいしてよい、我らを待つ必要はない
column3: Young man, we have business to attend to and are going out now. We won't return until tomorrow morning. You may close up - no need to wait for us.

column2: こんな夜更けに、お三方はどちらへ？
column3: At this hour? Where are you three gentlemen off to?

column2: 若いの……知らぬことが多いほうが、長生きできるぞ！
column3: Young man... the less you know, the longer you live!

column2: お前がなかなか聞き分けがよいから見逃してやったが、さもなくば昨日のうちに金蚕蠱を一匹くれてやったところだ！は……は……は～
column3: If you hadn't been so obedient, I'd have treated you to a Gold Silkworm gu yesterday! Ha... ha... ha...

column2: ふん、もったいぶりやがって……どうせろくなことをしに行くんじゃないぜ！
column3: Hmph, acting all mysterious... They're up to no good, that's for sure!

column2: まあいい！　客のことには首を突っ込まないでおくか……
column3: Forget it! Best not to pry into the guests' business...

column2: 止血草を手に入れた
column3: Got Styptic Herb

column2: 革帽子を手に入れた
column3: Got Leather Cap

column2: 木靴を手に入れた
column3: Got Wooden Clogs

column2: はっ！これはこの前泊まった鏢師の商売道具じゃないか？布団の中に一本落としていったのか……
column3: Ha! Isn't this what that escort guard who stayed here last time uses for his trade? He went and left one behind in the bedding...

column2: 梅花鏢を一本手に入れた
column3: Got a Plum Dart

column2: こりゃ何だ？
column3: What's this thing?

column2: 駆魔香を手に入れた
column3: Got Banish Incense

column2: にんにくを手に入れた
column3: Got Garlic

column2: 塩漬け肉を手に入れた
column3: Got Cured Meat

column2: 雄黄を手に入れた
column3: Got Realgar

column2: もち米餅を手に入れた
column3: Got Rice Cake

column2: 還魂香を手に入れた
column3: Got Soul Incense

column2: 龍涎草を一本摘んだ
column3: Picked a Dragon Grass

column2: 止血草を一本摘んだ
column3: Picked a Styptic Herb

column2: 果物を手に入れた
column3: Got Fruit

column2: 果物を手に入れた
column3: Got Fruit

column2: 籐甲を一着拾った
column3: Found a Rattan Armor

column2: 洪医師：
column3: Doctor Hong:

column2: どうした？どこも悪くないのに
column3: What's this? You're not sick,

column2: なぜ薬がいるんじゃ……
column3: so why do you need medicine...

column2: 洪医師：
column3: Doctor Hong:

column2: 李坊、また喧嘩でもしたのか？
column3: Little Li, been in a fight?

column2: まったく……この程度の傷なら
column3: Really... A few needles and

column2: 鍼を打って揉めばすぐ治るわい
column3: a rubdown will fix this up.

column2: 洪医師：
column3: Doctor Hong:

column2: ふふ、ご近所じゃ、金は取らんよ
column3: Heh, no charge for a neighbor.

column2: 洪医師：
column3: Doctor Hong:

column2: ここに上等の霊芝が一つ残っとる
column3: I've one fine lingzhi left.

column2: 長年のご近所じゃ、お前にやろう
column3: As an old neighbor, take it.

column2: じゃが元気を補うだけの薬でな、
column3: But it only restores vigor.

column2: 李おばさんの病はどうにもならん
column3: I can't cure Aunt Li, sorry...

column2: 洪医師：
column3: Doctor Hong:

column2: まだ薬が入り用かね？
column3: Need more medicine?

column2: 丁おじさん：
column3: Uncle Ding:

column2: も…もうだめじゃ…ぜえ、ぜえ
column3: I... I'm done for... Hff, hff

column2: ぜえ……ごほっ
column3: Hff... cough!

column2: 李のお兄さん、お願い、助けて。父さんの喘息が急にひどくなったの。洪医師を呼んできてもらえないかしら
column3: Brother Li, please help us. My father's asthma has suddenly flared up. Could you fetch Doctor Hong for us?

column2: 今度の発作は急だし、こんな真夜中だし、わたしたち姉妹、どうしたらいいのか分からなくて
column3: The attack came on so fast this time, and it's the middle of the night. We sisters simply don't know what to do.

column2: うう～、どうしよう……どうしよう……
column3: Waah... what do we do... what do we do...

column2: 洪医師、開けてください～
column3: Doctor Hong, open the door, please!

column2: 洪医師！洪医師～
column3: Doctor Hong! Doctor Hong!

column2: こんな真夜中に、戸を叩くのは誰じゃ～
column3: Who's that knocking in the middle of the night...?

column2: 洪おじさん、お手数ですが……丁おじさんの喘息がまた出たんです。かなりひどいようなので、急いで診に行ってあげてください……
column3: Uncle Hong, sorry to trouble you... Uncle Ding's asthma has flared up again, and it looks really bad. Please hurry over and see him...

column2: う～、うむ……すぐに行こう
column3: All... all right... I'll be right over.

column2: もう安心じゃ。容体は落ち着いた、危険はない。万一何かあったら、またわしを呼びに来なさい
column3: You can rest easy. He's stable now and out of danger. If anything should happen, come and get me again.

column2: 李のお兄さん……わ……わたしたち、何とお礼を言えばいいのか
column3: Brother Li... I... we don't know how to thank you.

column2: いいって、大して役に立ったわけじゃない。ひとっ走りしただけさ……
column3: Don't mention it. I didn't do much - just ran an errand...

column2: ありがとう……
column3: Thank you...

column2: 李兄さん……あたし怖い～。ここにいて、一緒にいてくれない？
column3: Brother Li... I'm so scared. Won't you stay here with us?

column2: 医者がもう言っただろ、親父さんはもう大丈夫だって。安心しな。俺はちょっと用があって、山神廟まで行ってくる
column3: Didn't the doctor just say so? Your dad's going to be fine. Don't worry. I've got something to do - I'm heading over to the Mountain God Temple.

column2: それって西の十里坡を通るんじゃない？聞いた話じゃ～、あそこは夜になるとお化けが出て人を食べるって、すごく怖いのよ……
column3: Doesn't that mean going through Ten-Mile Slope to the west? They say... at night ghosts and monsters come out there and eat people. It's really scary...

column2: ははは～、それは大人が子供を脅かすための話だろ。お前も信じてるのか？
column3: Hahaha! That's just something grown-ups say to scare children. You believe that?

column2: 今朝、ある老先輩と山神廟で会う約束をしたんだ。剣法を教えてくれるってさ
column3: This morning I arranged to meet an old master at the Mountain God Temple. He's going to teach me swordplay.

column2: あなたこそおばかな子供よ。あの頭のおかしい飲んだくれのじいさんの言うことを真に受けるの？
column3: You're the silly child here. You actually take that crazy old drunk at his word?

column2: ふん～、行けばいいでしょ……もう知らない
column3: Hmph! Go on then... see if I care.

column2: お前のおかげで、今夜もまた眠れなくなったわい
column3: Thanks to you, there goes my night's sleep again.

column2: はっはっは！若いの、ちゃんと約束を守ったな
column3: Hahaha! So you kept your word after all, lad.

column2: おばさんの目が厳しくなければ、老先輩にうまい酒を何本か持ってくるつもりだったんですが
column3: If my aunt didn't keep such a close eye on me, I'd have brought you a few jugs of good wine, Master.

column2: ほっほ！それには及ばん。わしは天下の名酒を飲み尽くしてきた。酒の虫がひどく騒がなければ、あんな水で薄めた酸っぱい酒などありがたがるものか。
column3: Heh heh! No need for that. This old man has drunk every famous wine under heaven. If the craving hadn't been gnawing at me so fiercely, I'd never have cared for that sour, watered-down stuff.

column2: お恥ずかしいかぎりです。田舎の小さな店で、美酒も馳走もなく、行き届かぬところはどうかご容赦ください
column3: You put me to shame, Master. Ours is just a little country inn with no fine wine or delicacies. Please forgive our poor hospitality.

column2: は～はっは！それでこそまともな口の利き方じゃ。わしは生涯、人に借りを作ったことがない。今から剣の技を一手教えてやる。酒を恵んでくれた恩返しじゃ、よく見ておれ
column3: Ha... haha! Now that's talking like a decent fellow. I have never in my life owed anyone a debt. I shall teach you one sword technique now, as repayment for the gift of wine. Watch closely.

column2: 先輩！どうか俺を弟子にしてください。
column3: Master! Please take me as your disciple.

column2: 貧道は昔から流浪に慣れておってな、弟子は取りたくない
column3: This poor Taoist has always been a wanderer. I do not wish to take disciples.

column2: 先輩～、お願いです……俺は先輩の残りの生涯お世話をし、お供して義侠の道を行い、四海を巡り歩きます……
column3: Master, I beg you... I'll look after you for the rest of your days and follow you across the four seas, righting wrongs and upholding justice...

column2: この一手の剣法を学べば、一生尽きることなく役に立つ。お前とわしの縁はここまでじゃ、家へ帰れ……
column3: Learn this one sword technique and it will serve you without end all your life. Our fated meeting ends here. Go home...

column2: せ……先輩！まだお名前も伺っていません
column3: M... Master! I don't even know your honored name yet!

column2: 遠くから朗々と詩を吟じる声が聞こえてくる
column3: From far away comes a ringing voice reciting a poem

column2:
剣を御し風に乗りて来たり　天地の間に魔を除く
"酒あらば逍遥を楽しみ　酒なくも我また狂う"
"一たび飲めば江河を尽くし　再び飲めば日月を呑む"
"千杯なお酔い倒れず　ただ我こそ酒剣仙"
column3:
Sword-borne on the wind I come, to purge all demons under heaven
"With wine I roam carefree; without it, I am mad all the same"
"One draught drains the rivers dry; another swallows sun and moon"
"A thousand cups can't lay me low - I alone am the Wine Sword Immortal"

column2: 酒……剣仙？
column3: Wine... Sword Immortal?

column2: えっ……もう夜が明けたのか。まずい～、帰ったらまた叱られるぞ
column3: What... it's morning already? I'm in for it now - I'll get another scolding when I get back.

column2: 昨日の晩はまたどこで遊んでたんだい？朝まで帰ってこないで、店の戸にかんぬきもかけずに！泥棒に入られたらどうするんだい！
column3: Where did you run off to play last night? Not back till morning, and you didn't even bolt the inn door! What if we'd been robbed!

column2: おばさん！昨日の晩、仙人に会ったんだよ。朝早く店の入口に寝転がって酒をねだってたあの道士さ。剣法までひと通り教えてくれたんだ、見てみないか……
column3: Auntie! I met an immortal last night! It was that Taoist who was lying at our door begging for wine early in the morning. He even taught me a set of sword moves - want to see...

column2: 寝言を言ってるんじゃないよ。そうだ……あの苗族のお客さんたちが今朝戻ってきて、もう一部屋追加で取りたいってさ
column3: Stop talking nonsense in your sleep. Oh, by the way... when those Miao guests came back this morning, they asked for one more room.

column2: でも……うちの宿は客間が二つしかないだろ
column3: But... our inn's only got two guest rooms.

column2: 二階へ上がってもお前がいなかったから、お前の部屋を片付けて、ひとまずお客さんに使ってもらったよ
column3: I went upstairs and couldn't find you, so I tidied up your room and let the guests have it for now.

column2: えっ！じゃあ俺はどこで寝るんだよ？
column3: What! Then where am I supposed to sleep?

column2: あの人たちは今晩には発つんだ、ちょっと我慢おし。一日昼寝しなくたって死にゃしないよ
column3: They're leaving tonight, so just put up with it. Going one day without a nap won't kill you.

column2: へえ～、俺の部屋には誰が泊まってるんだ？
column3: Oh? So who's staying in my room?

column2: 誰も泊まっちゃいないよ。ふくらんだ麻袋を一つ担ぎ込むのを見ただけさ。それに、あたしたちの誰もあの部屋に入るなってさ
column3: Nobody, actually. I just saw them carry in a bulging burlap sack. And they won't let any of us into that room.

column2: へえ？あの連中、やけにこそこそしてるな。もしかして何かのお宝じゃ……
column3: Oh? That bunch is awfully secretive. Could it be some kind of treasure...

column2: 人様のことをそんなに気にしてどうするんだい？さっさと顔を洗って、朝ご飯にするよ
column3: What do you care about other people's business? Go wash up and get ready for breakfast.

column2: このまま出て行ったら見つかってしまう
column3: I'll be spotted if I walk out like this.

column2: おはよう！おばさんの病気は少しはよくなったかい？
column3: Morning! Is your aunt feeling any better?

column2: おかげさまで、もう大丈夫です
column3: Thanks to you, she's fine now.

column2: 李坊や、おばさんは病み上がりなんだから、もうあんまり無理をさせるんじゃないよ
column3: Little Li, your aunt's only just recovered from a serious illness. Don't let her wear herself out again.

column2: 父さんが病気なの。お医者様は、この数日さえ乗り切れば大丈夫だって。わたしたち姉妹で交代で看病しないと
column3: My father is ill. The doctor says he'll be all right if he can just get through the next few days. We sisters have to take turns nursing him.

column2: 丁おじさんには、君たちみたいな親孝行ないい娘が二人もいるんだ。きっとよくなるさ
column3: With two good, devoted daughters like you, Uncle Ding is sure to get better.

column2: 李兄さん、父さんのお見舞いに来てくれたの？
column3: Brother Li, did you come to see how my father is?

column2: 父さんの病気は長年の持病なの。でもずっと治らなくて
column3: Father's illness is an old complaint of many years. It just never gets cured.

column2: こそこそ何をのぞいてやがる？指図もないのにこの部屋に近づくな！
column3: What are you sneaking around peeking at? Stay away from this room unless you're told otherwise!

column2: 逍遥兄ちゃん！抜け道の作り方を教えてよ、いいでしょ？
column3: Brother Xiaoyao! Teach me how to build a secret passage, okay?

column2: それは……むちゃくちゃだろ。親父さんに知れたら、間違いなくぶたれるぞ
column3: That's... way too reckless. If your dad found out, you'd get a hiding for sure.

column2: でも～、兄ちゃんだって自分の部屋に抜け道を作って、下の薪小屋までつなげてるじゃないか
column3: But... you built a secret passage in your own room, going down to the woodshed below!

column2: しーっ、大声を出すな。おばさんに知れたらおしまいだ。また今度教えてやるよ
column3: Shh! Don't shout. If my aunt finds out, I'm done for. I'll teach you some other day.

column2: また今度かあ～。逍遥兄ちゃんはすぐごまかすんだから
column3: Some other day again... Brother Xiaoyao always weasels out of things.

column2: うわ！年頃の娘さんだ…………あれ～、どこかで会ったような？
column3: Whoa! It's a young lady... ...Huh? Haven't I seen her somewhere before?

column2: お嬢さん～、これはいったいどういうことだい？あいつらはどうして君をさらってきたんだ？
column3: Miss, what's going on here? Why did those men kidnap you?

column2: うう～、おばあ様……わたし、戻っておばあ様を助けなきゃ！
column3: Sob... Granny... I have to go back and save Granny!

column2: しーっ、声を出すな……
column3: Shh! Don't make a sound...

column2: 貴様、どうやって忍び込んだ！
column3: How did you sneak in here!

column2: おい～、お前ら、この娘さんをここへ縛って連れてきて、いったい何をたくらんでるんだ？
column3: Hey! What are you people up to, tying this young lady up and bringing her here?

column2: 俺たち拝月教のことには首を突っ込まないほうが身のためだ！
column3: You'd best keep your nose out of Moon-Worship Cult business!

column2: へっ～、ここは俺ん家がやってる宿だ。首を突っ込まないわけにいくか
column3: Heh - this is my family's inn. Of course it's my business!

column2: 死にたいか！
column3: You're asking to die!

column2: 小僧、なかなかやるな。引き上げるぞ！
column3: Not bad, brat. You win this one. We're leaving!

column2: あの苗族の連中は、どうして君をさらったんだ？
column3: Why did those Miao kidnap you?

column2: おばあ様……おばあ様がひどい怪我をして、わたしとても心配なんです。お願いです、わたしを島へ連れて帰ってください。おばあ様が死んでしまいます……
column3: Granny... Granny is badly hurt, and I'm so worried. Please, take me back to the island. Granny is dying...

column2: 島……？　どの島だ？
column3: Island...? Which island?

column2: もちろん仙霊島です！！
column3: Xianling Isle, of course!!

column2: 分かった分かった～、慌てないで、落ち着いて。こうしよう……俺が船を借りてきてやる
column3: Okay, okay, don't panic. Calm down. Tell you what... I'll go borrow a boat for you.

column2: 空っぽの麻袋が一つ
column3: An empty burlap sack

column2: お前、気でも狂ったのかい！お客さんを怒らせて、うちの商売はどうなるんだい？
column3: Have you lost your mind! Offending the guests - do you want us to stay in business or not?

column2: おばさん～、あの苗族どもは娘をかどわかす悪党だったんだ。この娘さん、危うく連れ去られて売り飛ばされるところだったんだぜ
column3: Auntie, those Miao are nothing but girl-snatching scoundrels. This young lady was nearly carried off and sold!

column2: おやまあ～　そりゃ懲らしめて当然だね。おや？この娘はどこのお宅のお嬢さんだい。見かけたことがないけど？
column3: Goodness me! They deserved a thrashing, then. Hm? Whose daughter is this girl? I've never seen her before.

column2: おばさん～、そんなにじろじろ見るなよ！俺、この娘さんをなるべく早く家まで送り届けなきゃ
column3: Auntie, stop staring at her like that! I have to get this young lady home as fast as I can.

column2: さっさと行ってさっさと帰っておいで！また面倒を起こすんじゃないよ
column3: Go quickly and come straight back! And don't get into any more trouble.

column2: くれぐれも、もう面倒は起こすんじゃないよ……
column3: Whatever you do, stay out of trouble...

column2: 聞き間違いじゃないよな？この娘さんも仙霊島へ行くって！
column3: Did I hear that right? This young lady wants to go to Xianling Isle too!

column2: お嬢さん！あんたも仙丹をもらいに行くのかい？仙霊島は面白い所なんかじゃないぜ。聞いた話じゃ～、島には人を食う妖怪がいるそうだ！
column3: Miss! Are you going to ask for a magic pill too? Xianling Isle is no place for a pleasure trip. They say... there are man-eating demons on that island!

column2: でたらめです！　妖怪なんかじゃありません
column3: That's not true! They are not demons!

column2: 四兄さん～　頼む頼む……今、力になってくれるのは兄さんしかいないんだ。詳しく説明してる暇はないけど、とにかく人の命に関わることなんだ
column3: Brother Si... please, please... You're the only one who can help me right now. There's no time to explain, but the long and short of it is, a life is at stake.

column2: 分かった……逍遥の頼みとあっちゃ、この四兄さんがとことん付き合ってやるさ～、船に乗れ！
column3: All right... since it's you asking, Xiaoyao, your Brother Si will see it through to the end. Climb aboard!

column2: 乗りかかった船だ、もうひとっ走りしてやるか！
column3: In for a penny, in for a pound - I'll make the trip once more!

column2: 今度は何だい！　何があったんだい？
column3: Now what! What's going on?

column2: 動くな！さもなくばこの婆の命はないぞ
column3: Don't move! Or this old woman dies.

column2: あ……貴様！卑怯だぞ！！おばさんを放せ……
column3: Ah... you! You coward!! Let go of my aunt...

column2: 誰が婆だって！目の見えないろくでなしども、このあたしが何者なのか、先によく聞いて回ってくるんだね？
column3: Who are you calling an old woman! You blind fools should have asked around first and found out just who this lady is!

column2: あたしの店で暴れようってのかい？騒ぎを起こすならよそへ失せな。さもないとお前らの骨をばらして出汁にしてやるよ！
column3: You dare run wild in my inn? If you want trouble, take it somewhere else, or I'll pull your bones out and boil them for soup!

column2: おい……そこの黒い顔の？　おい……
column3: Hey... you with the dark face? Hey...

column2: しまった～　うっかり穿雲掌を使っちまった。このでぶ、たぶんもう助からないね……
column3: Oh dear... I slipped and used the Cloud-Piercing Palm. This fat one's probably done for...

column2: うわ……おばさん！すっげえ強いじゃないか……
column3: Whoa... Auntie! You're amazing...

column2: こんな半端者、あたしの眼中にないよ。その昔、このおばさんはね……まあいい……よしとこう。
column3: Third-rate trash like this isn't worth my notice. Why, back in my day, your aunt... never mind... let's not go into it.

column2: こら～　何を喜んでるんだい。人死にが出たんだよ！どう始末をつけるんだい？
column3: Hey! What are you so happy about? Someone's been killed! How are we going to clean up this mess?

column2: この苗族の賊どもは人を殺して物を奪い、か弱い娘をさらったんだ。死んで当然さ！おばさんは天に代わって成敗したんだよ
column3: These Miao bandits murder and rob and carry off helpless girls. Death is too good for them! You were just carrying out Heaven's justice, Auntie.

column2: 何言ってんだい……気楽なことばかり言って。あとで役人に聞かれたら、どのみち面倒なことになるんだよ
column3: Oh, get away with you... easy for you to say. It'll be nothing but trouble when the officers come asking questions.

column2: それで……この娘さんはどうする？家族がみんな災難に遭ったんだ。放っておくわけにはいかないだろ？
column3: So... what about this young girl? Her whole family has met with disaster. We can't just abandon her, can we?

column2: はあ～　むごいことだね……それじゃ、ひとまずここに住まわせてあげよう。二階の静かな部屋を選んで、ゆっくり休ませておやり。こんなひどい目に遭って、さぞつらいだろうからね。よく面倒を見てあげるんだよ、思い詰めたりしないようにね！
column3: Sigh... what a cruel thing... Then let her stay here for now. Go upstairs and pick a quiet room so she can get some proper rest. After something so terrible, her heart must be breaking. Take good care of her, and don't let her do anything rash!

column2: 大丈夫……分かってる
column3: Don't worry... I know.

column2: 本当に疲れ切ってたんだな……
column3: She really was worn out...

column2: 趙霊児は眠りについた……
column3: Zhao Ling'er has fallen asleep...

column2: あの娘は大丈夫かい？
column3: Is the girl all right?

column2: 横になったとたんに眠ったよ。どうやら……一晩中一睡もしてなかったみたいだ
column3: She fell asleep the moment her head hit the pillow. Looks like... she hadn't slept a wink all night.

column2: そうかい……ここはもういいから、部屋にお戻り……
column3: All right... you're not needed here anymore. Go back to your room...

column2: その夜……
column3: That night...

column2: 抜け道は壊れている……
column3: The secret passage is broken...

column2: あ……きっとこの前、苗族と喧嘩したときに壊れたんだ
column3: Ah... it must have been wrecked in that fight with the Miao.

column2: 抜け道は壊れている……
column3: The secret passage is broken...

column2: 戸の外からすすり泣く声が聞こえる……
column3: The sound of weeping comes from outside the door...

column2: 誰だい？
column3: Who's there?

column2: どうしたんだ？
column3: What's wrong?

column2: 逍遥お兄ちゃん……わたし、怖い……わたし……またおばあ様が……される夢を……
column3: Brother Xiaoyao... I'm so scared... I... I dreamed again that Granny was...

column2: 怖い夢を見たのか？大丈夫……ここは安全だ。俺もおばさんも君を守るから……
column3: Did you have a nightmare? Don't be afraid... you're safe here. Auntie and I will both protect you...

column2: わたし、あなたと一緒に寝たいです……
column3: I want to sleep with you...

column2: えっ！？　一緒に……
column3: What!? Together...

column2: それは……ちょっとまずいだろ！？
column3: That's... not really proper, is it!?

column2: どうしてだめなんですか……？
column3: Why not...?

column2: 君のことは気の毒だと思うけど……その、男女七歳にして席を同じゅうせず……分かるだろ？
column3: I do feel for you, but... well, a man and a woman must keep a proper distance... you understand, right?

column2: あなた……わたしのことがお嫌なんですね！
column3: You... you don't want me near you, do you!

column2: うう……逍遥お兄ちゃんも霊児がいらなくなったんですか？！
column3: Sob... Doesn't Brother Xiaoyao want Ling'er anymore, either?!

column2: 俺！？　それは……
column3: Me!? Well...

column2: 逍遥！　この娘をいじめたのかい？
column3: Xiaoyao! Have you been bullying the girl?

column2: そんな度胸あるわけないだろ！？
column3: As if I'd dare!?

column2: あんなろくでなしは放っときな！
column3: Pay no mind to that rascal!

column2: おいで……あたしの部屋へ。つらいことがあったらおばさんに話してごらん。おばさんが力になってあげるから！
column3: Come... come to my room. Whatever's troubling you, tell Auntie all about it. Auntie will set things right for you!

column2: 翌日……
column3: The next day...

column2: ふふ～　ふふ～　この小僧ったら！
column3: Heh heh... heh heh... you rascal, you!

column2: おばさん……なんでそんな気味の悪い笑い方するんだよ
column3: Auntie... why are you grinning in that creepy way?

column2: あたしの前でとぼけるんじゃないよ！自分がどんな悪さをしたか分からないってのかい？
column3: Don't play dumb with me! You mean you don't know what mischief you've been up to?

column2: 俺！？　……俺がまた何したって？
column3: Me!? ...What did I do this time?

column2: あたしゃ決めたよ！！お前に霊児を連れて苗疆へ母親を捜しに行かせる
column3: I've made up my mind!! You're taking Ling'er to the Miao lands to find her mother.

column2: あの子、全部話したのか？
column3: She told you everything?

column2: へっ～　小さい頃から今まで……お前がこのおばさんに隠し通せたことが一つでもあったかい？
column3: Heh... In all your years growing up... has there ever been one thing you managed to keep from your aunt?

column2: 苗疆までは数千里もあるんだぜ！行くとなったら、十日や半月じゃすまないぞ！
column3: The Miao lands are thousands of li away, you know! If I go, I won't be back in just ten days or half a month!

column2: お前ももう大きいんだ。それに……お前のその性分じゃ……こんな田舎にじっとしていられるはずもない。若い者が外へ出て世間を見てくるのも悪くはないさ
column3: You're grown up now. Besides... with a nature like yours... you'd never be able to stay put in a backwater like this. It's no bad thing for a young man to go out and see the world.

column2: おばさん～　やっと俺のこと分かってくれたんだな！
column3: Auntie... you finally understand me!

column2: 調子に乗るのはまだ早いよ……この旅でね、お前にはあたしのために一つやり遂げてもらうことがある！
column3: Don't get carried away just yet... On this journey, there's one thing you must get done for me!

column2: はは！一つどころか、百だってやってやるよ！
column3: Ha! Never mind one - make it a hundred!

column2: 趙夫人にお会いしたら……面と向かって縁談を申し込むんだ……霊児を妻に迎えたいとね。
column3: When you meet Madam Zhao... you are to ask her face to face for her daughter's hand... tell her you wish to take Ling'er as your wife.

column2: えっ！？
column3: WHAT!?

column2: 結婚という大事は～親の決めること！お前の縁談はもちろんこのおばさんが決める。霊児のほうは……母御がまだこの世においでなら、じかに申し上げるのが筋ってもんだ
column3: Marriage is a great matter - and it's for the parents to decide! Your marriage is naturally for your aunt to arrange. As for Ling'er... if her mother is still in this world, it's only right to ask her in person.

column2: もし……見つからなかったら？
column3: What if... we can't find her?

column2: 見つからなかったら、そのまま孫を抱いて帰ってきてもいいんだよ
column3: If you can't find her, you can just come home with a grandchild in your arms.

column2: そんなに早くいくもんか……
column3: It doesn't happen that fast...

column2: つべこべ言うんじゃないよ……この風呂敷包みを持ってお行き！
column3: Enough of your lip... take this Travel Bundle!

column2: 中には何が入ってるんだ？
column3: What's inside it?

column2: 自分で開けて見りゃいいだろ
column3: Can't you open it and see for yourself?

column2: お行き……道中気をつけるんだよ
column3: Off you go... take care on the road.

column2: 行こうか……！
column3: Let's go...!

column2: はい……
column3: Mm... okay...

column2: こうも振り回されちゃ、まったくくたびれるぜ
column3: All this running around has worn me right out.

column2: こんな骨折り損な仕事は、もう二度と俺に持ってこないでくれよ
column3: Don't come to me again with another thankless job like this.

column2: わあ～、仙女のお姉ちゃんだ！ぼく小虎だよ、覚えてる？
column3: Wow, it's the fairy sister! I'm Xiaohu - do you remember me?

column2: ええ～、もちろん覚えていますよ……小虎～、お父様の病気はよくなりましたか？
column3: Mm, of course I remember... Xiaohu, is your father all better now?

column2: あれ～、二人は知り合いなのか？
column3: Huh? You two know each other?

column2: そうだよ！　ぼくが話した仙女のお姉ちゃんって、この人のことだよ
column3: That's right! She's the fairy sister I told you about.

column2: 逍遥兄ちゃんと仙女のお姉ちゃん、あはは～、お似合いの二人だ！
column3: Brother Xiaoyao and the fairy sister - haha, a match made in heaven!

column2: どこへ行くの？ぼくも連れてってよ
column3: Where are you going? Take me with you, please?

column2: あ……こんにちは
column3: Oh... hello.

column2: 李のお兄さん……聞いたんだけど……遠くへ旅に出るの？
column3: Brother Li... I heard... you're going on a long journey?

column2: わたしのこと、忘れないでね……
column3: Don't forget me...

column2: 逍遥兄さん、あの女の子は誰？どうしてあなたの家に住んでるの？
column3: Brother Xiaoyao, who is that girl? Why is she staying at your house?

column2: 逍遥兄さん……行かないでよ～。あたし、寂しくなっちゃう……
column3: Brother Xiaoyao... don't go. I'll miss you...

column2: 逍遥兄ちゃん……ぼくも一緒に行く
column3: Brother Xiaoyao... I want to come with you.

column2: うう～　逍遥兄ちゃん、ちっとも構ってくれないんだもん
column3: Waah... Brother Xiaoyao doesn't pay any attention to me anymore.

column2: 逍遥兄さん～、その人は誰？どうしてあなたと一緒にいるの……
column3: Brother Xiaoyao, who is she? Why is she with you...

column2: こ……この子は俺の遠縁のいとこでさ、うちへ何日か遊びに来てるんだ
column3: She... she's a distant cousin of mine, come to stay with us for a few days.

column2: うそばっかり。あなたの家にいつ遠縁の親戚なんて湧いて出たのよ？あたし聞いたことないわ
column3: Liar. Since when did a distant relative pop up in your family? I never heard of one.

column2: ちょっと～！逍遥兄さんに手を出したら承知しないわよ
column3: Hey! Don't you dare get any ideas about Brother Xiaoyao!

column2: あら～、こちらはどちらのお宅のお嬢さんだい？よそから来たのかい？見かけない顔だねえ？
column3: Oh my, whose daughter might this be? From out of town? I've never seen her before.

column2: 誰がために洗い～誰がために忙しく……
column3: For whom do we wash... for whom do we slave...

column2: ほほ～、李坊……隅に置けないねえ！
column3: Ho ho... Little Li... you're quite something!

column2: この何日か、仙霊島に出入りする人が、どうして急に増えたんだろうね？
column3: Why are there suddenly so many people going to and from Xianling Isle these past few days?

column2: なあ李坊や～、お前もいい年なんじゃ、早いうちに嫁をもらって身を固めなさい。いつまでもおばさんに心配をかけるでないぞ
column3: Now listen, Little Li, you're no child anymore. It's time you took a wife and settled down. Stop making your aunt worry all the time.

column2: ほっほ～、わしとしたことが説教を始めてしもうた。薬を買いに来たんじゃろ？好きに選びなさい……
column3: Heh heh, listen to me, lecturing away. You've come for medicine, haven't you? Pick out whatever you like...

column2: 二人ともどうして怪我をしたんじゃ？盗賊の一味を追い払ったそうじゃな。ほっほ～、実に見上げた勇気じゃ！
column3: How did you two get hurt? I hear you drove off a gang of bandits. Heh - such courage does you credit!

column2: これからも入り用があればいつでも来なさい。洪おじさんはお前たちのような若者が大好きじゃ
column3: Come to me whenever you need anything. Uncle Hong is very fond of young people like you.

column2: おお～逍遥、いいところに来た。こっちへ来て手伝ってくれ……
column3: Ah, Xiaoyao, you're just in time. Come over and lend me a hand...

column2: あ……林の親方、ごめんよ。家にまだ用事があって、手伝えないんだ
column3: Oh... Master Lin, sorry. I've still got things to do at home, so I can't help you.

column2: はあ……お前ら若い者ときたら。村の柵にこんな大きな穴が開いとるのに誰も構いやせん。この老いぼれが自分で直さにゃならんとは
column3: Sigh... you young people, honestly. There's a great big hole in the village fence and nobody lifts a finger. These old bones of mine have to do the mending.

column2: 林の親方の大工の腕はこの町で一番だからな。こういうことは親方が出てくれば一発で片がつくさ
column3: Your carpentry is the best in town, Master Lin. A job like this is as good as done once you take it on.

column2: 口ばっかり達者じゃな……
column3: All talk, as usual...

column2: しっ！しっ！手伝う気がないなら脇へどいておれ。いつまでもここで邪魔をするな
column3: Shoo! Shoo! If you won't help, stand aside. Stop getting underfoot here.

column2: 欲しい物があったら自分で選びな……
column3: If you want to buy something, pick it out yourself...

column2: 材料が足りなくて、柵を直しきれなかった。また明日にでも竹板を仕入れてこよう
column3: I ran short of material and couldn't finish patching the fence. I'll go get more bamboo slats in a day or so.

column2: 結局のところ、あの悪ガキどもの仕業じゃ。言っても聞きやせん。しょっちゅう塀をよじ登って十里坡へ蝉捕りや鳥の巣探しに行くもんだから、登り崩してしもうたんじゃ
column3: When all's said and done, it's those little rascals. They never listen. They're always climbing over the fence to go catching cicadas and hunting bird nests on Ten-Mile Slope, and they've pulled it down.

column2: 何を買うんじゃ？
column3: What'll you have?

column2: おお～、逍遥……うちの小虎を見かけなかったかね
column3: Oh, Xiaoyao, my lad... you haven't seen our Xiaohu, have you?

column2: あの子はまたどこへ遊びに行ったのやら。こんなに遅いのにまだ帰ってこんのだ
column3: That boy's run off to play who knows where again. It's this late and he still doesn't know to come home.

column2: ほう……聞いたぞ、仙霊島まで仙薬をもらいに行って、おばさんの命を救ったそうだな
column3: Well... I hear you went all the way to Xianling Isle for the immortals' medicine and saved your aunt's life.

column2: うむ～、実に親孝行ないい子じゃ……
column3: Good, good... what a fine, dutiful lad...

column2: 大変だ～大変だよ、逍遥兄ちゃん！刀を持った悪者が三人、村じゅうで兄ちゃんを捜してるよ！すごく怖い顔してた……
column3: Oh no, oh no, Brother Xiaoyao! Three bad men with knives are searching all over the village for you! They look really mean...

column2: きっとあの死に損ないどもだな……へっ～、俺に仕返しする気か？あいつら今どこにいる？
column3: It must be those goons who don't know when they're beaten... Heh, looking for revenge, are they? Where are they now?

column2: 兄ちゃんが見つからないから、兄ちゃんの家で待ってるよ
column3: They couldn't find you, so they're waiting at your house.

column2: あ……おばさんは？
column3: Ah... what about my aunt?

column2: 李おばさんは野菜を買いに出て、まだ帰ってないよ。
column3: Aunt Li went out to buy vegetables and isn't back yet.

column2: 李兄さん……どうしてあんな苗族の人たちと関わり合いになったの？人死にが出るんじゃないかって、あたし怖くて
column3: Brother Li... how did you get mixed up with those Miao? I'm so afraid someone's going to get killed.

column2: ははは……俺は天に代わって悪を討ってるのさ。心配するな、今の俺は武芸の達人だ、誰も俺にはかなわないぜ……
column3: Hahaha... I'm carrying out Heaven's justice. Don't you worry - my kung fu is mighty now, and nobody can beat me...

column2: 逍遥兄ちゃん、がんばれ！
column3: Go, Brother Xiaoyao!

column2: あの悪者たちをやっつけちゃえ！
column3: Beat those bad guys to a pulp!

column2: 李兄さん、絶対に家へ帰っちゃだめ！苗族が三人、あなたの家で待ち構えてるのよ。あなたが現れなかったら、家を壊してやるって言ってるわ
column3: Brother Li, whatever you do, don't go home! Three Miao are waiting for you in your house. They say if you don't show up, they'll tear the place down.

column2: 何！それじゃ帰らないわけにいかないだろ？
column3: What! Then how can I not go back?

column2: ねえ……お役所に届けたほうがよくない？
column3: Listen... shouldn't we report it to the magistrate?

column2: いらないさ～、俺がいれば十分だ。あいつらは俺に負けた連中にすぎない
column3: No need - I'm all it takes. Those guys are just losers I've already beaten.

column2: でも……向こうは人数が多いのよ……喧嘩するなら何か得物くらい用意しなきゃ
column3: But... there are more of them... If you're going to fight, you should at least get some weapons ready.

column2: 漁港のそばの鍛冶屋の曾おじさんと大工の林さんの家で武器を少し売ってるわ。少しでも準備しておいたらどうかしら……
column3: Uncle Zeng the blacksmith by the fishing harbor and Carpenter Lin both sell some weapons at their places. I think you should get at least a little prepared...

column2: 分かった～分かったよ……
column3: All right, all right, I get it...

column2: それと……先にあたしが洪医師の所で傷薬を買ってきてあげようか？万一……万が一……
column3: And... shall I go to Doctor Hong's first and buy you some medicine for wounds? Just in case... just in case...

column2: ちぇっ……縁起でもないこと言うなよ！
column3: Tch... don't jinx me!

column2: ふん～、心配してあげてるのに……
column3: Hmph... I'm only worried about you...

column2: 逍遥兄ちゃん、すごく強いんだね！
column3: Brother Xiaoyao, you're so strong!

column2: 逍遥兄ちゃん、ぼくの師匠になってよ、いいでしょ？
column3: Brother Xiaoyao, will you be my master? Please?

column2: 怖い～、あなたたち、法術が使えるのね……
column3: How scary... you two can use magic...

column2: 李坊、とうとうわしの船で働く気になったのか！？
column3: Little Li, have you finally decided to come back and work on my ship!?

column2: いや……方の旦那、俺たち兄妹は遠出をするんだけど、旦那の船に便乗させてもらえないかな？
column3: No... Boss Fang, my sister and I are going on a long trip. Could we hitch a ride on your ship?

column2: ちっ……まあよかろう。だが……この船は蘇州までしか行かんぞ
column3: Tch... oh, all right. But... this ship only goes as far as Suzhou.

column2: それでいい！
column3: That'll do!

column2: こんな真夜中だ、市場はとっくに閉まってる
column3: It's the dead of night. The market closed long ago.

column2: うわ～　は～　俺は自由だ！
column3: Woo... hoo... I'm free!

column2: 李逍遥！痛い目に遭いたいのかい？あたしのことを鬼婆だなんてよくも言ったね！
column3: Li Xiaoyao! Are you itching for a beating? How dare you call me some kind of hag!

column2: いてて～、痛いよ！
column3: Yeow! That hurts!

column2: また白昼夢を見て！お前ももういい年なんだよ。一日中ふらふらして、まともな仕事の一つも覚えようとしない！
column3: Daydreaming again! You're no child anymore, and still you act the fool all day and never learn to do anything worthwhile!

column2: おばさん～　人を起こすたびに鍋だのお玉だのをがんがん叩くのはやめてくれよ、心臓が止まっちまう！うちのこの木の寝台は頑丈じゃないんだ、もし俺が転げ落ちて死んだら、李家は跡取りが絶えちまうぜ
column3: Auntie... please stop banging pots and ladles every time you wake me up - you'll scare me to death! And this wooden bed of ours isn't sturdy. If I fall and break my neck, that's the end of the Li family line!

column2: こうでもしなきゃお前が起きるかい？仮にもお前は林の親方に何か月か大工仕事を習ったんだろ。寝台がぐらつくなら自分で直せばいいじゃないか。木刀だの木剣だのを削ってばかりで、一日中父親の真似をして刀や剣を振り回して、ちっとも落ち着きがない。どこの娘がお前の嫁に来てくれるっていうんだい……
column3: Would you ever wake up otherwise? You did study carpentry under Master Lin for a few months, didn't you? If the bed's rickety, why not fix it yourself? All you ever do is whittle wooden sabers and swords and wave them around all day like your father, never settling to anything. What girl would ever want to marry you...

column2: じゃあ父さんはどうやって母さんを嫁にもらえたんだ？
column3: Then how did my dad get my mom to marry him?

column2: ちっ！お前の母親も父親とそっくりだったのさ。うちの李家に嫁いできても、針仕事ひとつせずに、父親と一緒になって暴れ回るばかりで……
column3: Tch! Your mother was just the same as your father. She married into our Li family and never touched a needle - all she did was run wild alongside him...

column2: へへ……みんな言ってるぜ～、二人は江湖の誰もがうらやむおしどり侠客だったって！
column3: Heh... Everybody says they were a pair of heroes, devoted as mandarin ducks - the envy of the whole martial world!

column2: そうかい～、侠客ねえ？義侠の道を行くと言って、お前みたいな厄介者を置いて、行ったきり帰ってこないじゃないか
column3: Oh, is that so - heroes? They said they were off to right wrongs, dumped a little troublemaker like you on me, and never came back.

column2: 結局はこの婆さんが爪に火をともすようにして、この小さな宿を開いて、お前をここまで育ててやったんじゃないか。その挙げ句がこんな怠け者とはね！
column3: And wasn't it this old woman who scrimped and saved to open this little inn and raise you this far? And all I've got to show for it is a lazybones!

column2: 誰が怠け者だって？
column3: Who says I'm a lazybones?

column2: 俺は将来、父さんと母さんみたいに天下無双の武芸を身につけて、四海を股にかけ、江湖に覇を唱える一代の大侠になるんだ！
column3: Someday I'll be like my mom and dad - I'll master peerless martial arts, roam the four seas, and be the greatest hero of my age, lord of the martial world!

column2: あたしの前でたわごとを言うんじゃないよ！
column3: Don't give me that rubbish!

column2: お前はね～、ぶらぶら遊び歩いてることで有名なんだよ。今回手が回らないほど忙しくなけりゃ、お前みたいな怠け者の手なんか当てにするもんか！
column3: You, my boy, are famous for loafing around. If I weren't run off my feet this time, I'd never count on a lazybones like you for help!

column2: こんな朝早くから客が来たのか？
column3: Guests already, this early in the morning?

column2: そうだよ……さっさと来て手伝いな！
column3: That's right... now get over here and help!

column2: つまんないなあ……朝っぱらからあれをやれ、これをやれって……
column3: What a drag... Do this, do that, first thing in the morning...

column2: へへ……ゆうべ作り上げた抜け道がちょうど役に立つぜ。今回はここから抜け出すとするか……
column3: Heh heh... The secret passage I finished last night comes in handy right now. I'll slip out this way this time...

column2: 逍遥！まだ部屋にこもって何してるんだい？早く出てきてお客さんの相手を手伝いな
column3: Xiaoyao! What are you still doing holed up in your room? Get out here and help me look after the guests!

column2: おう！　……今すぐ行くよ
column3: Okay! ...I'll be right there!

column2: ちぇっ～、まあいいか。抜け道は夜に使おう。今見つかったらおしまいだ
column3: Tch... oh well. I'll use the secret passage tonight. If I'm caught now, I'm done for.

column2: あ……そんなに金を持ってないや
column3: Oh... I haven't got that much money on me.

column2: いらっしゃい！ここにあるのは全部、今日もいだばかりの新鮮な果物だよ。いくつかどうだい？
column3: Step right up! Everything here is fresh fruit picked just today. How about a few?

column2: 一斤いくらだい？
column3: How much for a catty?

column2: お得意さんだ、一斤25文にしとくよ
column3: You're a regular, so I'll make it 25 coins a catty.

column2: わしはよく王さんに言っておったんじゃ～、年を取ったら野菜をたくさん食べて、脂っこい物は控えろとな。あいつは信じなかった。それが今度大病をして、すっかり菜食に変えおった。
column3: I was always reminding Old Wang - folks getting on in years should eat more greens and go easy on the grease. He wouldn't believe me. Now that he's had a serious illness, he's switched to eating nothing but vegetables.
